messages.author: 2ed19a7addb843f5
messages.subject: Displaying tables side by side
parts:
This seems like a simple thing but haven't found anything on it. Suppose I have 3 tables that I'm constructing and returning with renderTable(). They have many rows but few columns. Can I get these to display side by side as opposed to on top of one another?

Thanks.
Greg

messages.author: 1e1f6c27d3c442a5
messages.subject: Displaying tables side by side
parts:
Hi,

If you use googlevis tables, there is a dedicated merge futin, and if use regular renderTable, you should look at bootstrap syntax, which is something like :
div(class='row',
div(class='span6', tableOutput('table1'),
div(class='span6', tableOutput('table2')
)
